verdict.rationale: AMD's ROCm docs explicitly state the stack is 'primarily open-source' and list Linux x86 64-bit as a supported OS, which supports the general open-driver narrative, but the evidence never cites the amdgpu open-source kernel module or upstream Linux kernel driver support specifically for the RX 9070 XT. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the open-source amdgpu kernel driver/upstream kernel support, independent verification of open kernel module use for this specific GPU.
